claims.statement: For every restriction-closed Boolean class C satisfying G(g)<=aI(g)+bU(g) with finite a and 0<=b<1, every disjoint product qg with q an arbitrary-dimensional quadratic phase satisfies G(qg)<=max(3,a)I(qg)+bU(qg).
claims.quantifiers: Every quadratic dimension and rank; every interaction graph and monomial overlap; every g in C; disjoint physical coordinate blocks.
hypotheses: The seed GU' inequality holds uniformly on C
The quadratic and seed blocks use disjoint physical coordinates
claims.limitations: Transfers rather than proves a seed payment; disjointness is essential to the exact tensor identities.

claims.statement: For every integer k>=1, quadratic phases times arbitrary Boolean seeds on at most k disjoint variables form a restriction-closed class satisfying G<=max(3,k*2^(k-1))I, U<=2^(k-1)I, and H<=max(2,2^(k-1))I.
claims.quantifiers: Every k>=1, every quadratic block dimension/rank/graph, every Boolean seed on at most k variables.
claims.class_extension: Strictly extends quadratic phases for k>=3; includes arbitrary quadratic dimension with bounded arbitrary terminal cores.
claims.parameter_dependence: The displayed seed constants grow with k and therefore are not universal.

claims.statement: For disjoint Boolean products, U, H, I, and G are exactly additive.
claims.scope_guard: This is disjoint tensor additivity, not a general overlapping composition rule.
